evaluation_split: 20 percent by deterministic prompt hash within task; previous smoke items forced into development
primary_metric: equal-task mean of item-macro concept recall at 10, best rank across the five fixed layers, paired difference from matched logit lens
secondary_metrics: target-continuation exact greedy prefix accuracy where a target exists
uncertainty: 2000 paired task-stratified item bootstrap replicates; percentile 95 percent interval; descriptive for the released synthetic task distribution
concept_spellings: original and leading-space forms; no outcome-selected synonyms
causal_pairing: each argument swapped with the next cyclic argument in its category, all templates, all five fixed layers
causal_controls: three isotropic random perturbations matched to each full swap norm
random two-dimensional span ablation rescaled to the concept ablation norm
causal_metrics: counterfactual answer-token log-odds change against original answer
unmodified source and counterfactual task answer-token recovery
causal_note: Answer-token endpoints are first continuation tokens and do not establish full-answer correctness; ambiguous or truncated upstream labels remain visible. Uncovered or dependent frames are reported, not silently removed.
decision_rule: report all results regardless of direction; no minimum quality assertion in unit tests; no layer, corpus, spelling or threshold tuning using final test results
scope: Interpretability measurement on a small open model; not replication of all paper findings or a certification of alignment safety. FineWeb sampling does not reconstruct Qwen's pretraining distribution.
